fact: The fourth session of the Algerian-Tunisian Joint Technical Committee for Cooperation in post and ICT met in Tunis on 3-5 June 2026, co-chaired by Algeria's minister, and set up a joint spectrum working group.
title: Zerrouki Co-Chairs the 4th Session of the Algerian-Tunisian Joint Technical Committee for Cooperation with His Tunisian Counterpart
